chunks: And it is narrated that al-ʿĀlim عليه السلام was asked about two Thursdays that coincide in the last ten days.
So he said: “Fast the first, for perhaps you may not reach the second.”

key_terms.آخِرِ الْعَشْرِ: the last ten days of the month
key_terms.الْعَالِمُ: a title for the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.لَا تَلْحَقُ: you may not live to reach or attain
key_terms.يَتَّفِقَانِ: occur together or coincide within the same period

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Kāẓim عليه السلام say about fasting when two Thursdays fall in the last ten days?
ai.summary: This hadith advises giving precedence to the earlier opportunity to perform a recommended fast when two eligible Thursdays fall in the last ten days. It emphasizes acting promptly in worship because one may not live long enough to reach a later occasion.
